question: Can a drone recognize when its landing-pad detection is wrong?
hypothesis: A confidence-based check can reduce accepted wrong landing-pad locations on new camera data without rejecting nearly every detection.
goal: Know when to trust a landing-pad detection and when to hold it back.
finding: In 86 reused test frames under occlusion, Phase 23 had a correct box somewhere in 43 views, but its top-confidence box was correct in only 23.
method: Score the best detection, accept or abstain, then measure mistakes and coverage on separate camera sessions.
status: Independent camera validation is still pending.
